risk_or_blocker: Clean execution depends on Gurobi installation and a valid license.
impact: Blocks optimizer, live sandbox, command center, API imports, dashboard solves, and full pipeline.
mitigation: Provide documented solver installation/license preflight and a small solver smoke test.

risk_or_blocker: No automated tests protect existing validated behavior.
impact: Any refactor can silently invalidate published results.
mitigation: Establish baseline tests and golden-result tolerances before code changes.

risk_or_blocker: The project currently has only synthetic operational evidence.
impact: Real-hospital effectiveness and calibration cannot be claimed.
mitigation: Maintain a strict synthetic-only claim boundary until credible data is introduced.

risk_or_blocker: The current API entry point is broken.
impact: Frontend/backend separation and external integration cannot be demonstrated reliably.
mitigation: Repair packaging and verify with API smoke tests.

impact: Reported predictive metrics may overstate future generalization.
mitigation: Revalidate using time-ordered, scenario-held-out, and grouped splits.

risk_or_blocker: The digital-twin label exceeds current model fidelity.
impact: Reviewers may challenge the project as a Markov simulator presented as a full digital twin.
mitigation: Use precise terminology and document fidelity boundaries.

risk_or_blocker: Robust-optimization terminology exceeds the mathematical implementation.
impact: Research and interview claims may be challenged.
mitigation: Rename as uncertainty-adjusted optimization or implement formal robustness.

risk_or_blocker: The repository includes very large binary models and result artifacts.
impact: Git usability, cloning, review, and release management will degrade.
mitigation: Create an artifact retention and versioning policy.

risk_or_blocker: The 4-of-5 regime result is not statistically significant in the supplied headline table.
impact: The mean-comparison claim is valid, but strong superiority language is risky.
mitigation: State it as descriptive performance across scenarios, not proven superiority.

risk_or_blocker: No deployment, security, or observability foundation exists.
mitigation: Keep positioning at research-grade decision-intelligence prototype until stabilized.

risk_or_blocker: The supplied full-pipeline evidence is historical and environment-specific.
mitigation: Rerun after locking the environment and preserve logs, hashes, and outputs.

risk_or_blocker: Several result groups and RL rollouts are duplicated.
impact: Result provenance and scenario differentiation may be unclear.
mitigation: Add run manifests and remove or relabel duplicates.
